When ethanal is reduced by NaBH the product is ethanol, CH CH OH. The –CH OH group will contain one 1H atom and two 3H atoms. When this group is 3 2 2 oxidised back to –CHO a water molecule is produced, as described in the equation. This water molecule must contain at least one of the two 3H atoms from the –CH OH group. The ethanal molecule produced may have the 1H atom from the –CH OH group, or it may have one of the two 3H atoms from the –CH OH group. Therefore, both water and ethanal contain 3H atoms.
